notes.title: Speluncaphobia REWORKED!!! ( Game UN RETIRED )
notes.content:
Speluncaphobia has returned and has been remade! Though the game is relatively short, it now includes a fascinating cave system with a lore-driven plot that challenges you to uncover the truth behind the disappearance of multiple individuals lost within the depths of the cave. Additionally, the price has been adjusted to something more reasonable. I apologize for any confusion or inconvenience caused by the prior circumstances and hope you enjoy the new and improved version of the game.

Albeit being a short experience, there is still something there. 

You get to experience the morbid fear of caves. You get to experience [i]Speluncaphobia[/i].

notes.title: Speluncaphobia Rework - What will the game be like
notes.content:
Speluncaphobia, the retro caving horror game, is set to return to Steam with an exciting twist. Instead of the ambitious and weird idea of multiple caves stories, this time it features a single, larger cave that is shrouded in mystery, promising players an immersive and engaging experience like never before.

As you navigate the depths of the cave, you will unravel the secrets hidden within, encountering terrifying creatures and obstacles along the way. With the new changes in place, the game promises to provide an even more intense and thrilling adventure than before.

notes.title: Speluncaphobia Re-Imagined
notes.content:
We have some exciting news to share with all of you today! You might remember that, unfortunately, Speluncaphobia was retired from Steam some time ago due to the challenges of continuing development as a solo developer. But now, we're thrilled to announce that the game is making a triumphant return!

We've recently assembled a small but talented team of developers who share the same passion for creating a truly immersive and terrifying caving experience. With their support and expertise, we'll be able to bring Speluncaphobia back to life and deliver the game I originally envisioned.

Our primary goal has always been to capture the fear of being lost and alone in a cave, and with our new team, we're confident that we'll be able to achieve that more effectively than ever before. We'll be enhancing the game's atmosphere, incorporating realistic sounds, and refining gameplay mechanics to create a palpable sense of dread and isolation that will make your heart race, while still retaining the retro look.

Stay tuned for more updates on the game's development, and get ready to face your deepest fears in the dark, claustrophobic depths of Speluncaphobia.

[b]What will change:[/b]
Instead of multiple stories, Speluncaphobia will now have one, massive cave system. Your choices matter. You will be able to encounter spine chilling creatures, and you must figure out the mystery behind the cave that has taken many lifes along the years.



[b]The game will be unretired once the game is done. No ETA, but the development has already started. [/b]

notes.title: Game being retired
notes.content: The game is going off Steam. This game was supposed to be something big, but due to external issues the development just couldn’t continue. I am terribly sorry for anyone who expected this game to be big some day.
